summary: Stop plate_what_next from forcing PM dry-run solely because open_epic_count > 0 when the PM queue is idle (#905); idle path recommends first-slice epic closeout or stub refine. Document first-slice closeouts for #470/#656/#657/#658 on the v1 autonomy wiki page.
migration_impact: Agents and AutonomyEngine consumers: when pipeline empty and PM queue_size/open_assignments are 0, follow epic closeout/refine guidance instead of plate_pm_run_cycle. No package config change required.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core / pull release after merge.
2. Re-run plate_what_next / gh plate what-next with empty pipeline — expect priority epic (closeout/refine) not pm when queue idle.
3. For complete-child Epics, extend docs/wiki/V1-Autonomy-Surfaces-Epic-Closeouts.md and add status:implemented; residual E2E stays under #654.
agent_notes: Pairs with #904 active-only queue_size. PM still ranks first for checkpoints, delegated, proposed, and active queue. Do not re-check #654 boxes without E2E proof.
